_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the risk/fix keyword highlighting used by the finding drawer (web), the XLSX register and the PPTX deck. Each entry is a regex alternation fragment that must be valid in BOTH Python `re` and JavaScript (only \b, \w, (?:...), [...], ?, *, | are used). After editing, run `python scripts/generate_highlight_words.py` to regenerate the web mirror; test_codereview_report.py fails if the mirror is stale.
